approach: Write docs/system-facts.md as short sourced bullets, with budget lines in a fixed parseable form (`- budget <set>: <size> of <budget>`). Embed it in briefs.rs as `pub const SYSTEM_FACTS: &str = include_str!(...)` and emit a "## System facts" section in planner_brief and critic_brief. In budgets.rs, factor the existing set composition into a helper returning (name, size, budget) rows, add a checker that parses the file's budget lines and compares them to the computed rows, and test it on the real file and a doctored copy. Record the change in CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.

decisions.choice: Embed the file with include_str! in a pub const in briefs.rs and add a '## System facts' section to both briefs, after the request and reading and before the plan or checks.
decisions.reason: Both briefs carry the same text and the binary has no run-time dependence on docs/. budgets.rs reads the same const, so the test checks what ships.

rejected.option: Read the file at run time
rejected.why: The run-time copy has no docs/ and the snapshot may not match the binary.

rejected.option: Put it in the system prompt frames
rejected.why: It would spend the fixed planner and critic prompt budgets, which the request does not ask to change.

decisions.choice: Record sizes for the sets the budgets test already computes: contract, reader, producer, verifier, planner, critic (producer and verifier as the maximum across capabilities), and compare them and the budgets to the computed values.
decisions.reason: Uses existing numbers; drift in either size or budget fails the test.

rejected.why: Longer file; the request asks for a short one.

rejected.option: Add steward, audience and auditor sets
rejected.why: The budgets test does not compute them today.

decisions.choice: The checker is a function returning Result<(), String> taking the text and the computed rows; tests call it on the real file (Ok) and on a copy with one number changed (Err).
decisions.reason: Gives the required negative case without editing files.

rejected.option: Only assert on the real file
rejected.why: It would not show the test can fail.

decisions.choice: The file names boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs as the source and lists no banned word; the [personal_data] allow-list is referred to by name only.
decisions.reason: Satisfies criterion 2 and keeps the file clear of the scan.

rejected.why: Out of scope and would trip the scan.

files.purpose: Short sourced run-time facts, including budget lines in a parseable form.
Add SYSTEM_FACTS const, the section in planner_brief and critic_brief, and unit tests.
Factor set sizes into a helper; add the checker, real-file test and doctored negative test.
Entry for the file, brief inclusion and drift test.
Record the decision and why frames and budgets are unchanged.

steps: Read briefs.rs near boundary_words(), the tests module and the planner and critic fixtures.
Grep the sources for each fact (host rules, records branch, land, plan request parser, SSH admission, caches) and note each path.
Refactor budgets.rs so one helper returns (name, size, budget) rows; keep existing tests passing.
Write docs/system-facts.md with every required fact and its Source, filling budget lines from the helper.
Add pub const SYSTEM_FACTS and the '## System facts' section to planner_brief and critic_brief.
Add the briefs.rs tests: inclusion in both briefs, content markers, no '@', no banned words, size cap.
Add the budgets.rs checker, real-file test and doctored-copy test.
Add the CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md entries.
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: The parser is brittle against markdown edits.
risks.mitigation: Accept only the fixed line form, state it in the file, and fail if a set is missing.

risks.risk: The file bloats every planner and critic call or breaks their budgets.
risks.mitigation: Keep it short; a briefs test caps its bytes; budgets are not raised.

risks.risk: The file trips the boundary or personal-data scan.
risks.mitigation: A briefs test checks for '@' and every boundary word; the SSH example uses a placeholder.

risks.risk: A prompt edit changes a size so the file goes stale.
risks.mitigation: That is intended; the failing test message names the set and the computed value.

demonstrations.method: A briefs test asserts the file has a marker phrase for each required fact and a 'Source:' on every fact bullet and is under a byte cap; the verifier also reads the file against the criterion's list.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes; the file is short and each listed fact has a source.

demonstrations.method: A briefs test asserts the file has no '@', contains 'boundary_words' and 'xtask/tests/policy.rs', and contains none of the words from boundary_words().
demonstrations.fails_without: If a banned word or an email-like string were in the file, or the source pointer were missing, the assertion would fail.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests build planner and critic inputs from the existing fixtures and assert each output contains SYSTEM_FACTS.
demonstrations.observes: Both outputs contain the whole file text.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the section were not added to planner_brief or critic_brief, the contains assertion would fail.

demonstrations.method: system_facts_budgets_match_computed runs the checker on the real file; system_facts_drift_is_rejected changes one number in a copy and asserts Err naming the set.
demonstrations.observes: The real file passes and the doctored copy is rejected.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the checker did not compare numbers, the doctored copy would return Ok and the negative test would fail; stale numbers in the file would fail the real-file test.

demonstrations.method: The existing every_role_set_is_within_its_budget and an_over_budget_role_set_fails run in the same binary, now over the briefs that include the facts file, with budgets unchanged in the test.
demonstrations.observes: Both pass with the planner and critic sets within their budgets.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the included file pushed the planner or critic set over its budget, or the helper refactor broke the sets, every_role_set_is_within_its_budget would fail.

demonstrations.method: Review the diff of CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.
demonstrations.observes: A CHANGELOG entry and a decisions entry covering the file, the brief inclusion and the drift test.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check at the root.
demonstrations.fails_without: A failing new test, a clippy warning in the new code, or unformatted code would make the matching command exit non-zero.

open_questions: Exact current sizes are unknown until the helper runs; the producer fills the file from computed values.
Source paths for each fact must be found by the producer (host rules, records branch, land, plan request parser).
The briefs.rs test fixtures were not read; the producer reuses what exists.
